titles.title: The Only Humanoid Male Is a Yeti

description:
[Is XX with a non-human Yeti possible?]

Waking up from a nap on the bus after work just like any other day, I found myself in the middle of a massive snowfield.

A bleak and pure white winter landscape where snowflakes flutter and hands and feet freeze.

Staring blankly at that distant and surreal snowfield, Suna thought:    
'I've... been stranded!'   

She tried writing SOS in the snow and searched desperately for human traces, but what appeared was not a rescue helicopter.   

They were typical monsters of another world, yet bizarre monsters Suna had never imagined. The monsters each had their own species names, but to Suna, they all looked the same.

'Green monster (Goblin)! Stone monster (Golem)! Wolf monster (Direwolf)!'

However, there was one creature too ambiguous to be called a monster that caught Suna's eye. A creature too big to be human, and too human to be a monster.   
Thump, thump, thump, thump.   
Giant feet unlike a human's, a huge body covered in white fur, and blue skin.   
Walking with heavy, rhythmic steps, that was a monster from folklore—a Yeti.   
Suna looked up at him under the massive silhouette resembling a great mountain.   
There are no humans in this world. But there is a humanoid type like the Yeti, Utoom.   
'That's enough then.'  
Suna decided to accept it.
